scope: Whole-server weight-only ordinary batch-one target decode; metadata analysis, not measured model throughput.
limitations: Estimated layouts do not simulate all per-NUMA tensors or every dispatch.
Excludes MTP, KV/state, activations, repeated reads, replication, and cache reuse.
Resident weight estimate assumes all indexed tables are resident; actual mapping policy matters.
Different quantizations require their own quality and throughput evaluation.
